description.value: Ox King Noodles is a Vietnamese noodle restaurant located in downtown Victoria, tucked into a unit on View Street. It offers a menu with both vegan and vegetarian options, making it a welcoming stop for cyclists with dietary preferences. Its central Victoria location puts it within easy reach of major cycling routes through the city.

address.value: 1029 View Street, Unit 105, Victoria, BC V8V 0C9
